rationale: Vehicle collision resulting in totaled car and injury to the policyholder is a clear auto claim.
claim_summary: Policyholder Pat Morgan was rear-ended on Route 9 yesterday at 8:15am by another vehicle traveling at ~35 mph with no braking; the vehicle is totaled with extensive trunk/cabin damage. Claimant sustained whiplash and sprained wrist injuries. Other driver's insurance information is documented on the police report; claim has high severity due to vehicle total loss and injury.

case_facts.description: rear-ended by other vehicle at approximately 35 mph, no braking
case_facts.vehicle_damage: totaled; trunk crushed into back seat
case_facts.other_insurance: police report contains other driver's insurance info
